Title: Azure Storage classic metrics will be retired on 31 August 2023

Body.Content:
Because Monitor now provides rich, consolidated monitoring for Azure resources, we’ll retire classic metrics in Storage on 31 August 2023. Please transition to using metrics in Monitor by that date.

We encourage you to make the switch sooner to gain the richer benefits of Monitor. In addition to the classic metrics features you already use, Monitor provides:

  • New metrics and dimensions for extended monitoring.
  • Deep analysis in Azure Monitor Logs Analytics.
  • Native integration with other monitoring solutions.

Recommended action

To continue monitoring your Storage resources, transition to metrics in Monitor before 31 August 2023.

If you have questions, get answers from community experts in Microsoft Q&A. If you have a support plan and you need technical help, please contact us.
